Burn damage dealt by all allied units is increased by 5%. If this unit has [effect:27d1b457-e6a0-4327-9ee5-777be0028c79] or [effect:4b9440d5-b932-4dd3-acf1-a30e9a45d5c5], Burn damage dealt is increased by 20%.

data.effects:
Beneath her mysterious and elegant exterior hides a fathomless and bold desire. Nobody can tell what she is thinking; or perhaps her true feelings are reserved for a certain someone. 
"Hehehe, are you really that interested in probing my personal files? If you'd like to know more about me, then you should come ask me in person. I will bare everything to you, in thorough, exacting detail... holding nothing back."
